card.title: HURRICANE Mk I
card.flavorText: The Hawker Hurricane was a British single-seat fighter aircraft used by the Royal Air Force (RAF) and British Allies. The Hurricane was used in all the major theaters of WWII, and during the battle of Britain the Hurricane inflicted 60 percent of the losses sustained by the Luftwaffe in the engagement. It was slow, but maneuverable and could take a lot of damage, and even though it was not equal to the German BF 109 fighter or the British Spitfire in 1on1 dogfights, it did a very good job in taking down the German bombers.
